defs.def: the act or process of buying sth 购买；采购

ex.s: Under this Act, all waterfowl hunters 16 years of age and over must annually purchase and carry a Federal Duck Stamp.
ex.t: 根据该法案，所有16岁及以上的水禽猎人每年必须购买并携带一张联邦鸭票。

ex.s: Wilson will drive to the nearest store and purchase what's needed.
ex.t: Wilson会开车去最近的商店购买所需物品。

ex.s: If the consumer needs an amount of A costing 0.75, she can then spend only 0.25 X, the amount remaining, on her purchase of B.
ex.t: 如果消费者需要花费0.75美元的A金额，那么她只能花0.25 X，剩下的金额用于购买B.

ex.s: The purchase price could also be a signal that an established company is buying a new-born threat.
ex.t: 收购价格也可能是一个信号，表明一家老牌公司在收购一个新生威胁。

ex.s: "After I went on TV, a major Asian manufacturer of cosmetics was willing to purchase my product and help with its distribution.
ex.t: "我上了电视之后，一家主要的亚洲化妆品制造商愿意购买我的产品并帮助其分销。"

ex.s: Kings, nobles, and people of high rank wanted to purchase accurate pictures of themselves and the people they loved.
ex.t: 国王、贵族和地位崇高的人想要购买他们自己和他们所爱的人的精确画像。

ex.s: Consequently, they purchased a block of white marble more than 5 metres in length and 6,000 kilograms in weight.
ex.t: 于是，他们购买了一块长逾5米、重达6000公斤的白大理石料。

ex.s: In her study, Martin asked participants to rate their attachment to male, female, and genderless versions of a digital voice assistant and a self-driving car known as “Miuu.” It was found that gender increased users’ feelings of attachment to these devices and their interest in purchasing them.
ex.t: 在Martin的研究中，她让参与者对一款名为“Miuu”的数字语音助手和自动驾驶汽车的有性别、女性、无性别版本评价自己的依恋程度。研究发现，性别增强了用户对这些设备的依恋感以及购买兴趣。

ex.s: Since 1934, better than half a billion dollars has gone into that Fund to purchase more than 5 million acres of habitat.
ex.t: 自1934年以来，超过5亿美元进入该基金，用于购买500多万英亩的栖息地。

ex.s: REFLECTING dimension emerge exhibition guarantee investment purchase recognition representative visual 1 The first principle for any art collector is to only what you love.
ex.t: 反思 维度 涌现 展览 保证 投资 购买 认可 代表性 视觉 1 任何艺术收藏家的首要原则是只购买你真正喜爱的。

ex.s: Then, when you purchase the item, we will send you an attractive card for you to send to that loved one.
ex.t: 然后，当您购买该商品时，我们会寄给您一张精美的卡片，供您寄给那位心爱的人。

ex.s: If the consumer has X amount of money and wants to buy two goods A and B, she can only purchase goods totaling X.
ex.t: 如果消费者有X金额的钱并且想购买两种商品A和B，她只能购买总计X的商品。

ex.s: Among the bag makers' argument: many cities with bans still allow shoppers to purchase paper bags, which are easily recycled but require more energy to produce and transport.
ex.t: 在塑料袋生产商的说法中还提到：许多实施禁令的城市仍允许购物者购买纸袋，纸袋易于回收，但生产和运输耗能更多。

defs.def: something that you have bought 购买的东西；购买项目

ex.s: There' s nothing very complicated about this usage, a budget line is one of the lines in the budget, with the service or good to be purchased named and the cost quantified,
ex.t: 这种用法并不复杂，预算线就是预算中的一条线，注明要购买的服务或商品并量化成本，

ex.s: Data shows that kids and teens who do read frequently, compared to infrequent readers, have more books in the home, more books purchased for them, parents who read more often, and parents who set aside time for them to read.
ex.t: 数据显示，与不常阅读的孩子和青少年相比，经常阅读的孩子和青少年家里有更多的书，为他们购买的书籍更多，父母阅读更频繁，并且父母会为他们留出阅读时间。

ex.s: “Everyone can play a part in reducing waste, whether by not purchasing more food than necessary in your weekly shopping or by asking restaurants to not include the side dish you won’t eat,” Curtin says.
ex.t: “每个人都可以在减少浪费方面发挥作用，无论是在每周购物时不买超过需要的食物，还是要求餐厅不要上你不吃的配菜，”Curtin说。

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 每张鸭票所筹的每一美元中，约有98美分直接汇入候鸟保护基金，用于购置湿地和野生动物栖息地，并将其纳入国家野生动物保护区系统——这一事实确保了这片土地将受到保护，并为子孙后代所用。

defs.def: a firm hold on sth with the hands or feet, for example when you are climbing 握紧；抓牢；蹬稳

ex.s: I encourage readers to go to their local library when they can’t afford to purchase a book.
ex.t: 我鼓励读者在买不起书时，去当地的图书馆。
